newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Products files for 3.4 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Products files for 3.4 mln shr offer.

text.p: Morgan Products Ltd said on Tuesday it was filing a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a 3.4 million secondary common share offering.
The wood door and entrance systems manufacturer said in a statement the net proceeds would be used to reduce bank debt and provide a borrowing base to facilitate any future acquisitions.

The company said 1.5 million shares were being sold by Morgan and 1.9 million shares were being sold by Saugatuck Co Ltd Partnership. The underwriter would have the option to buy up to 510,000 additional shares from the company to cover over-allotment, it said.
Morgan said it would not receive any proceeds from the sale by Saugatuck.
"Under the terms of Saugatuck's partnership agreement, Saugatuck was terminated on December 31, 1995 and is in the process of winding up its affairs," Morgan said.
The company said the offering would be underwritten by Black & Co Inc and was expected to be made as soon as the registration statement became effective.
